abstract: This is a case of a young woman who had testicular feminization syndrome and developed a seminoma in an undescended intrapelvic testis. Androgen insensitivity (testicular feminization) syndrome is a rare inherited form of male pseudohermaphroditism that occurs in phenotypically normal women with adequate breast development, normal external genitalia, a vagina of variable depth, absent uterus, and sparse or absent pubic and axillary hair. The gonad (undescended testes) may be intraabdominal, inguinal, or labial. These patients characteristically have male karyotype (XY) and negative sex chromatin and are at increased risk of undergoing malignant transformation of the undescended gonad. We review the literature emphasizing the biochemical and endocrinologic abnormalities leading to the syndrome, as well as the morphologic abnormalities (light microscopic) of the undescended testes, diagnosis, and therapeutic management.
abstract_ja: 本症例は、精巣女性化症候群の若年女性が、停留精巣(腹腔内の骨盤内精巣)に純粋セミノーマを発生したものである。アンドロゲン不応症候群(精巣女性化症候群)は、表現型は正常な女性にみられる稀な遺伝性の男性仮性半陰陽の一型であり、十分な乳房発育、正常な外性器、様々な深さの膣、子宮の欠如、乏しいまたは欠如した恥毛および腋毛を特徴とする。これらの患者は典型的に男性核型(XY)で、性染色質陰性であり、停留精巣の悪性転化のリスクが高い。我々は、症候群の原因となる生化学的および内分泌学的異常、ならびに停留精巣の光顕所見(形態学的異常)、診断および治療的管理について文献を概説する。
